Name: StayUp Plus
Author: neur0tox1n
Description:
su226's StayUp mod updated for v1.6.0 Stardew Valley, with various fixes for multiplayer and better Night-to-Day light transitions.

config options:
[list]
[*]stayUp (default: true) toggle this mod on or off
[*]fullRestThresholdHours (default: 8) the minimum amount of hours you need to rest to restore your Stamina by 100%
[*]fullRestThresholdRestorationFactor (default: 1.0) the factor applied to the aforementioned 100% before final Stamina restoration calculations
[*]morningLight  (default: 400) the time at which to start the light transitions to daytime
[*]morningLightPower (default: 2) "Morning light power, for realism (2 means square, etc. Can be float.)"
[/list]
